rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and ZIP, matched to a single user, before accessing order details. It declined splitting payment as unsupported, identified the most expensive item, and sought explicit direction before making any order changes. When the user chose to cancel the entire pending order, the agent clearly stated the action and requested a cancellation reason as confirmation, then executed the cancellation via the correct tool. No writes occurred without confirmation, and the final confirmation and refund details were provided. There is minor risk that the stated total and payment method used were not explicitly shown in the visible tool output, but they are plausibly derived from the tools and do not contradict any provided data. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
